reviews.reason: A ReDoS in compiling repeated extglobs, with no patched release (<= 4.0.7; 4.0.7 is the latest). Reached only through dev tooling: vite, vitest, knip, tinyglobby and vite-plugin-pwa's rollup plugins; npm ls picomatch --omit=dev is empty, so nothing in the production runtime loads it. The patterns it compiles come from this repository's own build and test config, none of them an extglob, and no request input reaches it.
